title: Audio Gap Loop
user: A language learner or parent helping a child who needs repeatable listen-say-check practice from short audio without addictive gamification.
smallest_useful_product: A browser-only audio practice player: import personally owned clips, mark a transcript line, set listen/pause/repeat cadence, and keep a local completion log.
constraints: Users must supply material they may use; preserve all audio locally; include hearing-safe volume guidance and accessible transcript controls.
